en: A black‑and‑white vintage view of a small rural railway station labeled "ESPEN" on the station building. Curved train tracks run through the foreground toward a water tower and a house in the distance. Trees and low hills surround the line. In the top left corner in red letters is the caption "Espen St." and in the lower left corner there is a handwritten‑style date, likely "1908".
